# BC Registries & Online Services application sub-domain updates

_Category: Announcements · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**Fareen** (5/25/2023):

This is to inform you that the BC Registry application Production environment sub-domains listed in the table below are planned to be in effect beginning **June 11, 2023**. Users who are accessing old links will be redirected to the new sub-domain sites.

Note that the main BC Registry landing page ([www.bcregistry.gov.bc.ca](http://www.bcregistry.gov.bc.ca)) will NOT be changing and there will be no changes to the API connections currently used.

![Prod sub domain name changes|690x196](upload://yXJZ3ErO3hZ13UY8bR5YTdhji00.jpeg)


Please note that the webpage to view API specifications and access information has been updated to https://developer.api.bcregistry.gov.bc.ca.  Please update any bookmarks or saved links as needed.

If you have any questions or concerns related to this upcoming change, please reply to this post or email [REDACTED_EMAIL].  Thank you!
